# Gaps between the specification and the compiler that FuzzSplice
# (splice_fuzz_test.go) meets. FuzzSplice holds spliced programs to FuzzParse's
# and FuzzCompile's oracles under their keys, so a gap another target records
# is listed here too, citing that target's line. Each minimal reproduction in
# testdata/fuzz/FuzzSplice/ is an archive and has a corpus line.
# <target> <key> <owner> <what is missing, with the decision it breaks>
FuzzSplice  feature:d365-declaration  compiler  D365 (Chapter 26 Modules rule 5): a module declaration's .d.ts keeps the body's relative .ts specifiers (FuzzCompile feature:d365-declaration in compile.txt)
FuzzSplice  feature:parse-span-CallExpression  compiler  D61: a schema error's extends clause parses to a CallExpression with an inverted span (FuzzParse feature:parse-span-CallExpression in compile.txt)
FuzzSplice  feature:estree-range-CallExpression  compiler  Chapter 28 Linting (D277): a schema error's extends clause converts to a CallExpression whose range ends before it starts (FuzzParse feature:estree-range-CallExpression in compile.txt)
FuzzSplice  feature:declaration-consumer-TS2306  compiler  Chapter 27 rule 4 (D312, D366): a .vibe file whose only statement is its platform import, import "vibelang/platform/node", emits JavaScript that is a module (export {}) and an empty .d.ts that is not, so a TypeScript consumer that imports it is TS2306
FuzzSplice  corpus:declaration-platform-import-only  compiler  Chapter 27 rule 4 (D312, D366): the minimal reproduction of feature:declaration-consumer-TS2306
FuzzSplice  feature:source-map-range:one-past-end  compiler  D34: a top-level match's source map has a segment one character past the end of the .vibe text (FuzzCompile feature:source-map-range:one-past-end in compile.txt)
FuzzSplice  corpus:source-map-match-end  compiler  D34: the minimal reproduction of feature:source-map-range:one-past-end
